name: n8n
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: n8n is a workflow automation tool that connects apps and APIs with a visual editor. Runs n8n with its SQLite database and usage reporting off; open the server's address to create the owner account.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing n8n's packages (this takes a few minutes)"; rm -rf node_modules; npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress --no-update-notifier --loglevel=error && npm cache clean --force --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; export N8N_USER_FOLDER=/home/container N8N_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} N8N_LISTEN_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED={{N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED}} N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED={{N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED}} N8N_HIRING_BANNER_ENABLED=false N8N_SECURE_COOKIE={{N8N_SECURE_COOKIE}} GENERIC_TIMEZONE={{GENERIC_TIMEZONE}} N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS=true; unset WEBHOOK_URL N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL; if [ -n "{{PUBLIC_URL}}" ]; then export WEBHOOK_URL="{{PUBLIC_URL}}" N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL="{{PUBLIC_URL}}"; fi; exec node node_modules/n8n/bin/n8n start

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# n8n: picks n8n's version from npm and writes the package.json for it.
# Its packages are installed when the server starts, for the Node.js
# version it runs (and only again when the version or the Node.js version
# changes). Workflows, credentials and settings (.n8n/) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
pkg=n8n
reg=https://registry.npmjs.org/n8n

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' "$reg") ||
    fail "The npm registry can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta")
else
    version=$(jq -r --arg v "$want" 'if .versions[$v] then $v else empty end' <<<"$meta")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "n8n has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta"), then reinstall."
fi

cat > package.json.new <<JSON
{
  "name": "n8n-server",
  "private": true,
  "description": "n8n, installed by the server's egg. Change Version and reinstall to update.",
  "dependencies": {
    "$pkg": "$version"
  }
}
JSON
mv -f package.json.new package.json
mkdir -p .n8n
echo "Installed n8n $version (its packages are installed when the server starts)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The n8n version to install, such as 2.47.7, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The full public address of n8n, starting with http or https, used for webhook URLs and links. Leave it empty to use the server's address.

variables.name: Secure cookie
variables.description: Send the sign-in cookie over HTTPS only. Turn it on once n8n is behind HTTPS; with it on, signing in over plain HTTP fails.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: The time zone schedules run in, such as Europe/Berlin.

variables.name: Usage reporting
variables.description: Send anonymous usage data to n8n and check for new versions.
